summary: Reproduced all three silent correctness failures in the Triton causal_conv1d_update fallback, then fixed tail-aligned reads for oversized linear state, cache_seqlens-based circular history and in-place writes, and explicit rejection of widths outside 2-4. Regression coverage compares GPU output and the mutated state against an independent torch.nn.functional.conv1d plus gather/scatter reference across wrapped and unwrapped ring boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the checked-out implementation: oversized linear output mismatch, circular state mutation mismatch, and width 5 did not raise. Raw output: reports/j-c4c3fd74f1ba/raw/failing_before.txt
Full existing Triton update suite plus regressions: 209 passed before the final two boundary parameters were added. Raw output: reports/j-c4c3fd74f1ba/raw/triton_update_suite.txt

Clean-cache compilation and execution of the real Triton kernel: 5 passed, covering oversized state, ring cursors 0, 2, and 5 (wrapped and unwrapped boundaries), exact in-place state equality, and width rejection. Generated AMDGCN, HSACO, LLVM IR, TTGIR, and TTIR artifacts are listed in reports/j-c4c3fd74f1ba/raw/triton_compiler_artifacts.txt; raw test output is in reports/j-c4c3fd74f1ba/raw/clean_cache_gpu_run.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: Executed on card0, AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), with PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and Triton 3.7.0. Environment evidence: reports/j-c4c3fd74f1ba/raw/environment.txt. Clean-cache compilation emitted _causal_conv1d_update_kernel.hsaco and _causal_conv1d_update_kernel.amdgcn before all focused numerical tests passed.

remaining_limitations: The real Triton kernel was compiled and executed on the assigned AMD MI355X/ROCm GPU; the reporter's NVIDIA RTX 4090/CUDA architecture was not available in this environment. No native C++ or FlyDSL component was changed or rebuilt. The existing speculative-decoding state-window behavior was preserved; combining cache_seqlens circular mode with num_accept_tokens is rejected because those state models are not jointly defined by the wrapper contract.
